standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that every irreducible subset is contained in an irreducible component
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source line 1156)
standard_prerequisites.use: Finds a component containing one of the given closed subsets.

core_obligations: Components among the members: an irreducible component is covered by the traces of the given closed subsets, so irreducibility forces it to be one of them, and maximality makes it equal to that member (proof lines 1150-1155)
Conversely: each member lies in an irreducible component, which by the previous step is another member, so irredundancy of the union forces the two to coincide (proof lines 1156-1162)
proof_roadmap: 设 Y 是不可约分支，Y = ∪ (Y ∩ X_i) 且各 Y ∩ X_i 在 Y 中闭 ⇒ 由 Y 不可约，Y = Y ∩ X_i ⇒ Y ⊂ X_i ⇒ 由极大性 Y = X_i。
反之取 X_i，由「不可约集含于某不可约分支」得 X_i ⊂ Y，而 Y 是某个 X_j；由无冗余 X_i = X_j。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a finite irredundant union of closed subsets the irreducible components of the space are exactly the members of the union (author lemma at source lines 1141-1148, label lemma-pick-irreducible-components). The proof (source lines 1150-1163) shows first that a component must be one of the members by covering it with the traces and using irreducibility and maximality, and conversely that each member is a component by irredundancy (proof lines 1150-1162). The two inclusions are the content. H3.
